title: e2e test socket path collides across concurrent runs
notes: PARTLY FIXED 2026-09-15. A per-process atomic sequence number was added, so same-process collisions are gone: hire-grpc/tests/e2e.rs uses subsec_nanos() plus SEQ.fetch_add. STILL OPEN: no std::process::id() component (grep finds none) and the path is still a hardcoded /tmp rather than std::env::temp_dir(), so the scenario the bead actually names -- two concurrent cargo test runs -- can still collide. Relevant since 4632471: a collision now means the second daemon is REFUSED with AlreadyRunning rather than silently stealing the socket, so the failure is loud but the test still fails.
